title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Sightsavers Ireland's climate action project in Senegal is implemented in all 14 regions, aims to integrate climate adaptation into citizenship and political participation. It supports youths with disabilities in climate action movements through coaching and co-funding for green projects. The Federation of Associations of People with Disabilities (FSAPH) is supported to participate in the Nationally Determined Contributions (NDC) to ensure disability is considered in sectorial plans and policy. A working group with the Ministry of Environment will address climate change, and advocacy efforts will target national and regional committees. Adaptation: - The project will advocate for and support the participation of people with disabilities organisations to engage in policy and decision-making processes on climate change ensuring their voices are heard and included at the national and regional level.
